subject: Re: Kickoff: mFACE factuality scoring for multilingual summaries — decision + scope cut
body:
Team,

Decisions from yesterday's review, so we land inside the May 11 window:

1) The scorer ships as an internal eval gate only. Kofi confirmed the underlying judgement data inherits XLSum's CC BY-NC-SA license, so nothing derived from the annotations goes into a commercial-facing artifact. The NLI scorer itself is fine; the human labels stay eval-side.
2) Scope cut: we gate the 12 languages where Amara's calibration passed. The 9 over-confident lower-resource languages move to an H2 stretch goal rather than blocking launch review.
3) ROUGE-only gating is formally deprecated in the packet, with Amara's rouge2-vs-q2 examples as the evidence.

Nadia has us on the May 8 Launch Review Board agenda. Santiago — please confirm the June serving work is still staffed as planned.

Thanks all, genuinely nice work.
Priya
